heading: Education and training opportunities for Coast Guard spouses

tree.heading: Tuition Assistance.—
tree.text: The Commandant may provide, subject to the availability of appropriations, tuition assistance to an eligible spouse to facilitate the acquisition of—

children.text: education and training required for a degree or credential at an accredited college, university, or technical school in the United States that expands employment and portable career opportunities for the spouse; or

education prerequisites and a professional license or credential required, by a government or government-sanctioned licensing body, for an occupation that expands employment and portable career opportunities for the spouse.

tree.heading: Definitions.—
tree.text: In this section, the following definitions apply:

children.heading: In general.—
children.text: The term “eligible spouse” means the spouse of a member of the Coast Guard who is serving on active duty and includes a spouse who receives transitional compensation under section 1059 of title 10.

children.heading: Exclusion.—
children.text: The term “eligible spouse” does not include an individual who—
is married to, but legally separated from, a member of the Coast Guard under a court order or statute of any State or territorial possession of the United States; or
is eligible for tuition assistance as a member of the Armed Forces.

children.heading: Portable career.—
children.text: The term “portable career” includes an occupation that requires education, training, or both that results in a credential that is recognized by an industry, profession, or specific type of business.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 2904 was renumbered section 5104 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2021—Subsec. (b)(1)(B). Pub. L. 116–283 substituted “an individual” for “a person” in introductory provisions. 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 542 of this title as this section.

notes.heading: Second Expansion of the My Career Advancement Account Program for Military Spouses
notes.text: Pub. L. 116–92, div. A, title V, § 580G, Dec. 20, 2019, 133 Stat. 1410, provided that: “The spouse of a member of the Coast Guard may participate in the My Career Advancement Account program of the Department of Defense if the Coast Guard reimburses the Department of Defense.”
